1: Any person within the city who Loans money of deposits of personal property or deals in the purchase or possession of personal property on condition of selling the same back again to the pledgor or depositor, or who loans or advances money on personal property by taking chattel mortgage security thereon, and takes or receives such personal property into his possession, is hereby declared to be a pawnbroker.
2: It shall be unlawful for any person to conduct or transact a pawnbroker business or pawnshop in the city without first having procured a license.
3: Application for pawnbrokers’ license shall be made to the City Clerk and shall state thereon the name of the applicant and the place of business. The Chief of Police or any other officer of the city designated by the City Council shail investigate each applicant for such license and shall report back to the City Council whether or not such applicant is a person of good character, no license shall be issued to a person who has been convicted of the offense of theft by receiving stolen goods or of burglary or robbery, or theft by taking.
4: If a pawnbroker shall not conduct said business for a period of ninety days, the license shall be null and void. Pawnbrokers licenses shall not be transferable to any other person, except by a majority vote of the City Council, and the filing cf an application by the person to whom such license is, or Bay be, transferred or assigned. It shall be unlawful for any person to do business, or attempt to do business, under a license transferred to him without such approval of the City Council.
5: All pawnbrokers, in addition to other records, shall keep books wherein shall be entered an accurate description of all property received by or pledged or sold to them. Such description shall include the brand name of the article, any identifying mark, number, initial, social security number or name of any person or company, and a statement of the kind of material of which it is made. In such books there shall be entered also the name, age, address, signature and identification number from a drivers License or similar identification of the person by whon same was delivered, deposited or sold, the name of the broker, agent or employee receiving the item, the time when such transaction occurred, the price entries shail be made no later than one hour after the transaction. No entry made in such book shall be erased, obliterated or defaced. All books and records required by this article shall at all times be subject to inspection and examination by any law enforcement officer of the Town of Pine Mountain or the State of Georgia.

Every business licensed hereunder shall make a daily report in writing of all property in writing of all property pledged or purchased during the business day and surrender the report to the Pine Mountain Police Department by 12:00 noon the Foliowing day. Such report shall be legibly written or typed in English and shall show: the name and address of the business; time of transaction; sequel numbers of the pawn or purchase tickets; amount paid or advanced; fuil description of articles, including identifying names, marks, numbers, initials, or social security numbers; and a description of the person selling or pawning said items inciuding name, address, color, weight and height.
7: The record of each pawn or purchase transaction regulated by this article shall be maintained for a period of not less than four (4) years from date of transaction.
8: It shail be unlawful for any pawnbroker, pawnshop keeper, his servant or employee to receive any goods, articles or things in pawn or pledge from a person who is intoxicated, under the influence of drugs, insane, or a person under the age of eighteen years.
9: Tt shall be unlawful for any pawnbroker to employ any clerk or person under the age of eighteen (18) years of age to receive any pledge or Rake any loans.
10: The holder of a pawnbroker’s license shall be responsible for any and all acts of his employees, and for any violation by them of the provisions of this ordinance.
11: Every person licensed hereunder shall, immediately upon request, turn over to the Pine Mountain Police Department every item believed by the Police Department to be a stolen item. The Police Department shall furnish a property receipt including a case number to the dealer Surrendering such items. Said items shall be returned to the licensee only after it has been determined that such item is not stolen. if it is determined that such item is stolen it shall be returned to its lawful owner.
12: No pawnbroker shall receive as a pledge or purchase any blackjack, brass knuckles or sawed-off shot gun and no pawnbroker shall display in his window or shop any such weapon for sale.
13: Every pawnbroker licensed under the provisions hereof shall provide a safe place for the keeping of the pledges received by him and shall have sufficient insurance on the property held on pledge, for the benefit of the pledgors, in case of destruction by fire or loss by theft.
14: Every employee of a pawnshop as hereinafter defined shall register his mame and address with the Pine Mountain Police Department and shall give his thumbprints, fingerprints and photograph taken and filed with the city.

The City Council may revoke any pawnbroker's license for repeated violations of the provisions of this ordinance. Any licensee shell have the opportunity for 4 hearing before such revocation.

SECTION XVI. LOCATION No pawnbroker's license shall be issued in any location in which such business is not permitted by the zoning ordinances of the city.
16: Any business licensed hereunder shall close their establishment and cease transacting business no later than six o'clock P.M. each day and begin their operation and commence transaction business at no time before seven o'clock A.M. each day. No business licensed hereunder shall open for business on Sundays or holidays.
